PLAINTIFF WILL ALSO DISMISS CASE #CGC-05-442751 WITH PREJUDICE, EACH SIDE TO BEAR OWN COSTS.
IF DEFENDANT DOES NOT COMPLY, WITH 24 HOUR PHONE OR WRITTEN NOTICE(POSTED), PLAINTIFF TO APPLY FOR JUDGMENT FOR IMMEDIATE POSSESSION, BACK RENT OF $4500, AND COSTS OF SUIT.
